description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the performance of four different models or methods across four distinct metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Metrics," and displays four groups in the following order: "EGP ↑", "TR-N ↓", "TR-S ↓", and "CCP ↑". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Performance," using a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.2. Each metric category contains a cluster of four adjacent bars. According to the legend, the bars are color-coded to represent different configurations: a blue bar with an obscured or redacted label, a yellow-orange bar for "RPG (CodeLlama-7B)", a green bar for "Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)", and a dark orange bar for "RPG (CodeLlama-34B)". In the "EGP ↑" category, the blue bar is the shortest in the chart at approximately 0.01, while the dark orange bar is the tallest overall at nearly 0.99; the yellow-orange and green bars are roughly 0.89 and 0.59, respectively. For "TR-N ↓", the values are approximately 0.71 (blue), 0.46 (yellow-orange), 0.62 (green), and 0.40 (dark orange). In the "TR-S ↓" group, the blue bar reaches about 0.69, followed by yellow-orange at 0.42, green at 0.45, and dark orange at 0.31. Finally, the "CCP ↑" category shows the blue bar at 0.40, yellow-orange at 0.72, green at 0.70, and dark orange at 0.94. The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order, and there are no specific visual emphases such as outlines or shading, aside from the grayed-out text in the first legend entry.
